**Finding: deviation (§ 12.4, p0045)**

§ 12.4 imposes a one-sided restriction on us alone and hits walk-away territory on three counts: it is a true **no-hire** ("solicit, hire, or employ"), it covers **all** Vendor employees rather than only those involved in the Services, and it runs **24 months** — with "regardless of how the employee applies" expressly negating any general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. It also directly contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

Redline validated (ok:true): delete p0045, reaching the preferred position, with the mutual 12-month involvement-limited non-solicit offered as a fallback in the comment.
